name: Twister forest
description: A forest of twisted columns walked through in perspective — the Amiga twister instanced down a corridor over a grid floor, each column at its own depth, twisting at its own rate and sinking into the fog.

twist.description: Twist per unit of height. Far columns show more of it, because more of their height fits on screen.

walk.description: How fast the camera walks through the forest. 0 holds still; above ~2 the columns strobe past.
